I have updated the web-based textbook Logic and Proof by @Jeremy Avigad,
@Rob Lewis, and @Floris van Doorn to use lean4 instead of lean3.
The website is here https://leanprover-community.github.io/logic_and_proof/
and PRs are welcome on the github page https://github.com/leanprover-community/logic_and_proof
3 messages were moved from this topic to #general > logic and proof: discussion by Johan Commelin.
